security.altcha_description: The browser solves a short calculation before sign-in, password reset and sign-up: costly for a robot, unnoticed by a person. Self-hosted; SSO is not concerned.
security.altcha_difficulty_help: Between 1000 and 10000000. The default, 100000, takes well under a second on a recent device.

security.encryption_help: A copy of the storage volume or of a backup cannot be read without the key, kept outside it in the STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY variable. Losing the key means losing the encrypted files for good: keep a copy away from this server. See the documentation for existing shares.
security.encryption_key_absent: No key yet. Generate one with: docker exec CONTAINER_NAME ot-artisan generate-storage-key, keep a copy away from this server, then set it as STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
security.encryption_misconfigured: The key is missing or invalid: encrypted files cannot be downloaded and new shares are stored in plain text. Set STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY again.
security.ip_allowlist_description: Sign-in and sessions only from these networks, SSO included. Share links and the guests of file requests stay open from anywhere.

security.ip_allowlist_entries_help: One address or range per line, for example 203.0.113.10 or 10.0.0.0/8. After #: a comment.

security.mfa_policy_help: Those without a second factor set one up at their next password sign-in; their current session goes on. SSO accounts depend on their identity provider.

security.passkey_login_help: A passkey is enough to sign in: the device asks for a fingerprint, a face or a PIN. Off by default.
security.proxy_help: The address shown here must be your own. If it is your reverse proxy's, set TRUSTED_PROXIES to the proxy's address in the container environment: without it, the list sees the proxy for everyone.
